svg.title: Pick up: lift a box from the floor.
svg.text: Pick up: lift a box from the floor.

text.tspan: To take hold of something and lift it from a surface.
Please pick up the box by the door.
Both orders are possible: pick the box up; pick up the
box. With it, say pick it up, not pick up it.
A: This box is on the floor.
B: I can pick it up.
A: Please put it beside the door.
Your example. Explain “pick up” in your own words,
then use it in a sentence about making a room your
own. (Model: It means to lift something. Example:
